name: xyz.quantumatlas/switchboard
title: Switchboard: Voice Translation for Broadcast
description: Live English-to-multilingual voice translation and dubbing for broadcasts, events, and podcasts.

tools.name: switchboard_catalog
tools.description: Read the current language, rate and service catalog.

tools.name: switchboard_quote
tools.description: Quote the exact existing API order before paying; no speech is generated.

route.description: Target HTTP 402 route path or "METHOD /path" key (e.g. "/switchboard/chunk" or "GET /reality/harbor/state").

order.description: Route-specific JSON order payload (for example {"text": "Hello harbor.", "languages": ["es-US"]} on chunk jobs).

tools.name: switchboard_source_open
tools.description: Prepare a bounded media upload. Preserve the returned source_id and upload_key.

filename.description: Original media filename with extension for Switchboard source upload initialization.

total_bytes.description: Exact total byte length of the complete media file being uploaded.

upload_key.description: Secret upload capability token authorizing chunk appends, completion, and status reads for source_id.

tools.name: switchboard_source_append
tools.description: Append one bounded base64 media chunk at the exact offset; repeat the same chunk to recover.

source_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex identifier of an opened or finished Switchboard media upload.

upload_key.description: Secret upload capability token authorizing chunk appends, completion, and status reads for source_id.

offset.description: Exact byte offset in the uncompressed media stream where this base64 chunk starts.

data_b64.description: Base64-encoded binary media chunk for resumable Switchboard source upload.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the raw decoded media chunk bytes.

tools.name: switchboard_source_finish
tools.description: Finish the upload and probe its duration in the background. Poll source_get until ready.

source_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex identifier of an opened or finished Switchboard media upload.

upload_key.description: Secret upload capability token authorizing chunk appends, completion, and status reads for source_id.

tools.name: switchboard_source_cancel
tools.description: Cancel your prepared upload and remove its source data.

source_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex identifier of an opened or finished Switchboard media upload.

upload_key.description: Secret upload capability token authorizing chunk appends, completion, and status reads for source_id.

tools.name: switchboard_source_get
tools.description: Read your private upload status with its upload key.

source_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex identifier of an opened or finished Switchboard media upload.

upload_key.description: Secret upload capability token authorizing chunk appends, completion, and status reads for source_id.

tools.name: switchboard_job_get
tools.description: Read a private job with its read/session key or owned credit account; a bare id returns status only.

job_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex Switchboard job or live session identifier.

read_key.description: Secret capability token (32-128 URL-safe chars) granting read access to private job status and audio.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_recover_purchase
tools.description: Recover the settled durable job for the original official x402 payment identifier, even after the cashier replay cache expires. Requires the read/session capability preserved before purchase or owning credit; never starts work or charges.

payment_id.description: Original x402 payment identifier used to recover a settled durable Switchboard job.

read_key.description: Secret capability token (32-128 URL-safe chars) granting read access to private job status and audio.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_asset_get
tools.description: Resolve one private audio asset from your job receipt. Download the returned URL through the existing audio API; no media generation or payment.

job_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex Switchboard job or live session identifier.

file.description: Receipt-published audio filename to resolve (e.g. "es-US.m4a" or "es-US.wav").

read_key.description: Secret capability token (32-128 URL-safe chars) granting read access to private job status and audio.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_live_feed
tools.description: Read the contiguous terminal phrase feed. Use after=-1 for full catchup, then the last returned index.

job_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex Switchboard job or live session identifier.

after.description: Contiguous phrase index cursor (-1 for full catchup from the beginning, or the last returned phrase index).

tools.name: switchboard_card_balance
tools.description: Read your private credit account balance.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_card_orders
tools.description: Read your private credit account orders.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_card_order_get
tools.description: Recover one exact credit purchase by stable order_ref.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

order_ref.description: Client-generated 32-character lowercase hex idempotency reference preventing duplicate credit charges.

tools.name: switchboard_card_topup_ticket
tools.description: Prepare a wallet credit top-up ticket. Keep a newly returned credit key private.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_card_checkout
tools.description: Create the existing hosted card checkout for a credit pack. Payment occurs only at its checkout URL.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.

tools.name: switchboard_sheet_save
tools.description: Save an optional terminology/game sheet through the existing API.

sheet.description: Terminology and pronunciation game sheet preserving proper nouns and locked translations per language.

tools.name: switchboard_sheet_get
tools.description: Read a saved terminology/game sheet.

sheet_id.description: Identifier of a previously saved Switchboard terminology sheet (format: sh_<20 hex chars>).

tools.name: switchboard_live_say
tools.description: Submit one phrase to a paid live session. Preserve phrase_ref and exact text for retry recovery.

job_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex Switchboard job or live session identifier.

session_key.description: Secret live-session control capability token returned when opening a Switchboard live session.

text.description: English source sentence or script to translate and synthesize.

phrase_ref.description: Client-generated 32-character lowercase hex idempotency token for a single live-session spoken phrase.

tools.name: switchboard_live_close
tools.description: Close your live session asynchronously, drain running speech and produce recordings. Poll job_get.

job_id.description: 32-character lowercase hex Switchboard job or live session identifier.

session_key.description: Secret live-session control capability token returned when opening a Switchboard live session.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_status
tools.description: Read Audinate Dante Managed API control-plane readiness without contacting a vendor endpoint.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_domains
tools.description: List authorized Dante Cloud / Dante Domain Manager domains.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_domain_get
tools.description: Read device, TX channel, and RX channel inventory for an authorized Dante domain.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_route_plan
tools.description: Plan and validate a deterministic Dante TX-to-RX subscription route from live domain inventory without mutating crosspoints.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_route_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile a planned Dante route against fresh domain channel subscription status without retrying mutations.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_bridge_status
tools.description: Read Dante Cloud Media Bridge and smart-glasses ingress readiness.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_glasses_bind
tools.description: Authorize a smart-glasses (LiveLens), station-desk, or Switchboard return session to feed a Dante Cloud TX channel and mint a scoped ingress token.

mode.description: Audio ingress processing mode ("direct_pcm" passthrough or "switchboard_translate" translated return).

bridge_tx_device_id.description: Target Dante Cloud Media Bridge TX device identifier receiving ingress audio.

bridge_tx_channel_id.description: Target Dante Cloud Media Bridge TX channel identifier receiving ingress audio.

contributor_id.description: Optional field contributor or smart-glasses operator identifier.

room_id.description: Optional listener room or studio desk identifier associated with the bridge session.

switchboard_job_id.description: Existing 32-hex Switchboard live job identifier to bind to the broadcast pack or Dante bridge.

verify_route_plan.description: When true, validates the Dante TX-to-RX route plan against live domain inventory before binding.

ttl_seconds.description: Session or bounty expiration time-to-live in seconds.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_glasses_frame
tools.description: Push a bounded PCM16 audio frame from authorized smart glasses or a Switchboard bridge into an active Dante Cloud TX session using the session ingress token.

session_id.description: Active bridge or multi-turn conversation session identifier.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing zero-based audio frame sequence number.

pcm16_b64.description: Base64-encoded signed 16-bit little-endian PCM audio frame payload.

sample_rate_hz.description: PCM audio sample rate in Hz (16000, 24000, or 48000).

channels.description: PCM audio channel count for ingress frames (1 = mono, 2 = stereo).

pts_ms.description: Optional presentation timestamp in milliseconds for frame-accurate audio synchronization.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_dante_glasses_close
tools.description: Close an active Dante Cloud bridge or smart-glasses ingress session.

session_id.description: Active bridge or multi-turn conversation session identifier.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_broadcast_pack
tools.description: Prepare a turnkey Live Broadcast Pack combining Switchboard live order batches, Venue QR Audience Listener URLs, IPTV/LL-HLS #EXT-X-MEDIA alternate audio renditions, and optional Smart-Glasses-to-Dante Cloud ingress binding.

event_id.description: Unique live broadcast event identifier used to bind Switchboard renditions and listener rooms.

title.description: Human-readable title of the 50/50 NFT collaboration drop.

languages.description: List of 1 to 11 BCP-47 target language tags for multilingual Switchboard synthesis.

duration_minutes.description: Planned live broadcast event duration in minutes (1 to 240).

source_language.description: BCP-47 source audio/text language code (defaults to "en-US").

switchboard_job_id.description: Existing 32-hex Switchboard live job identifier to bind to the broadcast pack or Dante bridge.

register_hls_renditions.description: When true, generates #EXT-X-MEDIA alternate language HLS audio rendition manifests.

dante_domain_id.description: Optional Dante Domain Manager / Dante Cloud domain identifier for live broadcast audio routing.

bridge_tx_device_id.description: Target Dante Cloud Media Bridge TX device identifier receiving ingress audio.

bridge_tx_channel_id.description: Target Dante Cloud Media Bridge TX channel identifier receiving ingress audio.

contributor_id.description: Optional field contributor or smart-glasses operator identifier.

verify_route_plan.description: When true, validates the Dante TX-to-RX route plan against live domain inventory before binding.

ttl_seconds.description: Session or bounty expiration time-to-live in seconds.

bearer_token.description: Optional Audinate Dante Managed API / Dante Cloud OAuth bearer token for authorized domain operations.

tools.name: switchboard_chunk
tools.description: Switchboard small chunk: one or two English sentences synthesized in up to 11 target languages (stock voices), returning AAC audio per language and a WAV master ($0.15 per language) Pass the exact API body as order. An unpaid call returns HTTP 402 requirements and the exact purchase URL/body. Retry with the official payment signature, or use credit_key to spend owned credit (except credit/topup). Preserve order_ref and buyer supplied read/session keys.

order.description: Route-specific JSON order payload (for example {"text": "Hello harbor.", "languages": ["es-US"]} on chunk jobs).

payment_signature.description: Base64-encoded official x402 v2 payment authorization payload when paying by wallet instead of credit_key.

credit_key.description: Prepaid Stripe or Switchboard spend key (sbk_*) used to authorize and debit paid calls without crypto.
